BLUEJET: Higher Margins And Capital Plans Will Support Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have reset their price target on Blue Jet Healthcare to ₹600 from an earlier implied fair value of ₹821.68. The revision reflects updated assumptions that pair lower revenue growth of 19.27% with a higher profit margin of 25.83% and a more moderate future P/E of 35.60.

news.title: Consensus revenue estimates decrease by 11%, EPS upgraded
news.body: The consensus outlook for fiscal year 2027 has been updated. 2027 revenue forecast fell from ₹13.1b to ₹11.7b. EPS estimate increased from ₹15.90 to ₹17.25 per share. Net income forecast to grow 21% next year vs 20% growth forecast for Pharmaceuticals industry in India. Consensus price target broadly unchanged at ₹501. Share price fell 6.7% to ₹449 over the past week.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations while revenues lag behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹14.29 (down from ₹17.59 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹10.2b (down 1.4% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹2.48b (down 19% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 24% (down from 30% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was primarily driven by higher expenses. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 5.4%. Earnings per share (EPS) exceeded analyst estimates by 5.3%. Revenue is forecast to grow 17% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 11% growth forecast for the Pharmaceuticals industry in India.
